artifact: a ledger or zone export (WP-7.10): the archive, its bundle's entries, and the manifest the Host signs as the payload of a COSE_Sign1 permguard.ledger.export.v1 under host.operations
authority: 1-architecture/8-architecture-storage-operations.md#migration-and-upgrade, WP-7.10 decisions of 2026-10-24 (labels, types, cardinalities); crates/permguard-host/src/exports.rs, crates/permguard-control-plane/src/catalog/exports.rs
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: manifest
fields.note: the COSE_Sign1 permguard.ledger.export.v1 whose payload is an export_manifest

fields.name: bundle
fields.note: a canonical CBOR array of bundle_entry

fields.name: ledger
fields.note: the index of the ledger in the manifest's ledgers

fields.name: kind
fields.note: 1 an object, its canonical uncompressed bytes; 2 a head statement, the COSE_Sign1 as stored

fields.name: bytes
fields.note: the object or the statement, byte for byte

fields.name: ref
fields.note: with kind 2 only: the ref the statement attests

fields.name: v
fields.note: the record version, 1; another is refused

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: 16 bytes: the source authority, the Host that held the ledgers

fields.name: exported_at
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC

fields.name: zone
fields.note: the zone the ledgers belong to at the source

fields.name: ledgers
fields.note: each ledger once, by id and by name

fields.name: bundle_digest
fields.note: SHA-256 over permguard.ledger.export.bundle.v1 and a newline, then the bundle

fields.name: bundle_bytes
fields.note: the bundle's size; the manifest is at most 1 MiB

fields.name: id
fields.note: the zone's id at the source, 1 to 1024 bytes

fields.name: name
fields.note: its name, 1 to 1024 bytes

fields.name: id
fields.note: the ledger's id at the source: the authority-qualified identifier

fields.name: name
fields.note: its name

fields.name: default_ref

fields.name: refs
fields.note: every ref, each once

fields.name: objects

fields.name: statements
fields.note: how many head statements the bundle carries

fields.name: name
